About Us

Licensed Oil Marketing Company Operating Across Kenya & East Africa

Oilwave Energy Limited is a Kenyan Oil Marketing Company (OMC) licensed by the Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority (EPRA) to wholesale and export petroleum products throughout the region.

We are committed to reliable supply, regulatory compliance, and building lasting partnerships with clients across Kenya, Uganda, DRC, and South Sudan.

EPRA License Number
EPRA/PET/10894
What We Offer

Products & Services

Comprehensive petroleum solutions for local markets and cross-border trade

Local Bulk Supply

Reliable wholesale supply to distributors, retailers, and industrial clients across Kenya.

  • Automotive Gas Oil (AGO)
  • Premium Motor Spirit (PMS)
  • Depot-to-client delivery

Transit / Cross-Border

Specialized supply chain for transit fuel into neighboring East African markets.

  • Uganda & South Sudan
  • DRC via Western corridors
  • Customs & bond management

Logistics & Distribution

End-to-end logistics from importation through partner network to final delivery.

  • Fleet coordination
  • Depot storage
  • Real-time tracking
How We Work

Our Operations

From importation to delivery — a streamlined supply chain

Import, Store & Distribute

Oilwave Energy leverages Kenya's strategic position as a regional petroleum hub. We import through the Port of Mombasa, store at KPC-affiliated depots, and distribute via road.

Our partnership with Gulf Energy ensures consistent supply, while Gatlink handles clearing and forwarding.

1

Importation

Fuel imported via Mombasa port through licensed channels

2

Storage

Stored at KPC pipeline depots nationwide

3

Distribution

Road haulage to clients across Kenya and East Africa
